title: Bar Jayda
paragraphs: Bar Jayda “Melbourne has a really vibrant bar scene, but what you find here is very different,” says Shane Delia , the chef and restaurateur behind top Middle Eastern spots in Melbourne. Jayda is a new addition to Melbourne’s bar scene, masterfully designed by Studio Y .

The venue is divided into two distinct sections; at the front, the sophisticated dark and moody bar is surrounded by our bespoke Dais wall lamps featuring flame-red hand-blown glass orbs. Further back, through a glistening archway, is a sensual lounge room filled with velvet sofas and dipped and golden light shining from our handmade brass wall lights - Vitrine .

title: Cafe Brass
paragraphs: Cafe Brass Café Brass is a modern, all-day restaurant embracing Victorian history and European culinary traditions to bring you classic, easy dining in a stylish, laid-back atmosphere. ILANEL™ was commissioned to design and fabricate all lights at this upmarket venue: - Tree of Light, a multi tiered chandelier, featuring hand made brass branches and mouth blown glass shades. - Heavy Rain Wall Sconces at each side of the fireplace. - Heavy Rain Chandelier above the large meeting table. - The Kahdu 412D handwoven lampshades in burnt orange at each of the four corners of the bar. - Nipple sconces, featuring heritage Deco glass shades. - Golden pinspot pendants above the main dining area. - 2m Brass Comet linear pendants above the secondary dining area.
Lighting Design by Mint Lighting Photography by Ivan Lee/ IJ Production Related Products
